verdict.rationale: The evidence shows AnythingLLM runs locally or self-hosted and keeps documents on-device. That is a privacy posture, an adjacent property rather than documented controls for retention periods or deleting chats and documents. No evidence item describes retention settings, deletion workflows, or purge capabilities.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Every document becomes part of your agent's knowledge base with no data leaving your device.
